name: What questions should I ask when choosing a small-space planning specialist for my tiny home?

mainEntity.name: What questions should I ask when choosing a small-space planning specialist for my tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a small-space planning specialist, ask about their experience with tiny homes specifically and their portfolio of similar projects. Inquire about their design process, including how they approach maximizing space, integrating storage, and selecting materials. It's also important to understand their fee structure, project timelines, and how they involve clients in decision-making. Ask for references and clarify how they handle revisions or unexpected challenges to ensure a good fit for your project and vision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask specialists about their tiny home experience, design process, fee structure, project timelines, client involvement, and how they handle revisions.
